question_text:
Which revision best eliminates redundancy and wordiness in the following sentence from a DILG administrative order?

"The committee will meet together on a monthly basis every month to review and evaluate the progress of the implementation of the program."

options.text: The committee will meet together monthly to review and evaluate the progress of the implementation of the program.
The committee will meet monthly to review the program's implementation progress.
The committee will meet on a monthly basis every month to review the program implementation progress.
The committee will meet together every month to review and evaluate the program's implementation.
